requests.note: Server-side customization save, fired on Add to cart click. 'layer-896632' key = internal layer id for the 'cat1' (clipart-category, single) layer; value = the SAME _large.webp path as localStorage teeinblue-customizations. 'artwork-4339': 11533 is a new numeric id NOT present in the pre-submit localStorage snapshot -- appears to be a server-generated design/customization-line reference. No key at all for the 'body' (group-clipart-categories) layer, consistent with it having no selectable value (see SF-OBS group anomaly).

Native Shopify /cart/add. Line item properties are ALL underscore-prefixed (_customization_id, _customization_image, _tib_fulfilled_sku, _tib_design_link_1). No plain-text property naming the chosen clipart (e.g. no 'Select your clipart: no2/no1' key) is sent to Shopify's cart -- only opaque ids + a flattened preview image URL + a print-ready design file URL. Underscore-prefixed properties are conventionally hidden from Shopify's default cart/line-item-properties rendering, which matches SF-OBS cart-page observation (no raw property text shown, only variant options + a 'Preview design' lightbox link).
